content: Paul, Silas le Timothy te in, Pa Pathian le Topa Jesus Christ sung a om Thessalonica pawlpi te tung ah: i Pa Pathian le Topa Jesus Christ tung pan in thuthiamna le thinnopna note tungah hong om tahen.
Note theampo atu in Pathian tungah tatsat ngawl in lungdam ka ko uh hi, ka thungetna uh sungah hong pawk tawntung khu hi;
I Pa Pathian mai ah na upna uh taw na sepna uh, itna taw in na sep uh te le i Topa Jesus Christ sungah na lametna uh taw na thuakzawkna uh te kong phawk tawntung uh hi;
Kong it suapui te awng, Pathian tealsa te na hi uh hi, ci ka he uh hi.

Banghangziam cile i lungdamna thupha sia note tungah kam bek in hong theng ngawl hi, ahihang Thaa Thiangtho sungah vangletna le thinmuanna tampi taw hong theng hi; note atu in note sungah kote bangbang mihing khu ziam, ci na he uh hi.
Taciang note in Pathian thu sia haksatna tampi le Tha Thiangtho kung pan hongpai lungdamna taw sang zo na hi uhkom in, kote le Topa nungzui te na suak zo uh hi:
Tua ahikom Macedonia le Achaia a om thu um theampo tungah ettetak te na hi tavun.

Bangbangziam cile note tung pan Topa thu hong thawn sia Macedonia le Achaia bek hi ngawl in, Pathian na upna uh sia mun tatuam ah ki zel kakoai hi; tua ahikom thudang bangma ka son tuan tu om ngawl hi.
Banghangziam cile note kungah bangbang in hong tum khu ziam, ci thu ahizong, a nungta le a thuman Pathian na seam tu in milim te kung pan in Pathian kungah bangbang in kihei nu ziam, ci thu ahizong;
Taciang hongpai pheang tu Pathian thin-ukna pan in hong suaktasak le thina pan a thawkiksak a Tapa Jesus vantung pan hongpai tu na ngak na thu uh ahizong, amate in hong tangko zo uh hi.
